acceptance_checks: scripts/shiki_runtime_registry.py defines a standard-library-only runtime registry and descriptor contract for supported Shiki runtimes.

Registry descriptors include runtime name, display name, allowed roles, execution mode, auth mode, required tools, required secrets, related workflows, capability flags, experimental/deprecated status, and description.
Known runtime inventory includes codex, codex-front, claude-code, claude-code-action, github-cca, github-actions, hermes-runner, human, and other without removing legacy names.
scripts/shiki_contracts.py RUNTIME_NAMES is derived from or validated against the runtime registry to prevent drift.
scripts/validate_shiki.py validates .shiki/config.yaml runtime role assignments for known runtime names, required roles, supported role/runtime pairs, and legacy other rationale.
scripts/validate_shiki.py validates task assigned_runtime values against the registry while preserving legacy task records.
scripts/shiki_runtime.py uses the registry only for low-risk runtime validation and deterministic status output without introducing registry-driven dispatch.
docs/agents/runtime-registry.md documents runtime identity, runtime role, descriptor fields, execution mode, auth mode, required tools/secrets, capability flags, and non-goals.
docs/agents/decision-control.md, docs/agents/checklists.md, and docs/agents/runtime-auth-model.md reference the runtime registry contract without marking P1.3.4-P1.3.6 complete.
Target install, manifest staging, validator module-boundary checks, and tests include scripts/shiki_runtime_registry.py.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, registry import smoke, and git diff --check.
non_goals: Do not implement P1.3.4 GitHub host, protocol, or provider configuration.
Do not implement P1.3.5 doctor checks.
Do not implement P1.3.6 migration framework.
Do not implement new runtime adapters or external service integrations.
Do not implement a reviewer bot or GitHub App.
Do not change CCA Review Bridge behavior or semantics.
Do not change branch protection behavior or CODEOWNERS ownership rules.
Do not implement P1.4 governance or evidence model redesign.
Do not implement P2 packaging, release, or onboarding work.
Do not change Node.js 20 / Node 24 workflow compatibility policy.
scope: Define a canonical runtime registry and adapter contract for Shiki runtime identities, roles, auth modes, execution modes, capabilities, config role validation, task assigned_runtime validation, docs, and install/test inclusion.
title: Define runtime registry / adapter contract
